tools.changelog:
Initial release.
- PNG ↔ JPEG ↔ WebP
- Batch conversion
- Quality control

tools.name: CropFlow
tools.description: Resize, crop, and compress images with pixel precision. Aspect-ratio lock, custom dimensions, file-size targets.

tools.description: Merge, split, rotate, and convert PDFs and documents — all without uploading a single page.
tools.changelog:
Initial release.
- PDF merge / split
- Rotate & reorder pages
- Images → PDF

tools.name: QrFlux
tools.description: Generate styled QR codes and scan them from your camera or an uploaded image — completely offline.

- MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512
- Password generator with entropy meter
